# Third-party files in this folder (kept locally so the pages work without internet)

| File | What | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tailwind.js` | Tailwind CSS 3.4.17 "Play CDN" script (generates the CSS in the browser) | https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17 | MIT, (c) Tailwind Labs, Inc. |
| `inter.css`, `fonts/inter-*.woff2` | Inter variable font, latin + latin-ext | Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com) | SIL Open Font License 1.1, (c) The Inter Project Authors (https://github.com/rsms/inter) |

Thai text and the ฿ sign are not in Inter: they fall back to the system font (Segoe UI / Leelawadee UI on Windows).
